stories.title: Wahlen nach Plan: Die künftige Duma sieht so aus, wie es sich der Kreml gewünscht hat

en.title: Elections as planned: The future Duma looks the way the Kremlin wanted it
en.summary: Russia's ruling party United Russia secured its largest parliamentary faction since the Soviet Union's collapse. High voter turnout supports the Kremlin's narrative, though the credibility of these results remains questionable.

stories.title: Sunrise prüft den Abbau von 450 Stellen: Auch mithilfe von KI will sich das Unternehmen neu aufstellen

en.title: Sunrise examines cutting 450 jobs: The company wants to restructure also with the help of AI
en.summary: Swiss telecom company Sunrise announces its second round of layoffs this year, potentially affecting nearly one-fifth of its workforce as it pursues restructuring.

stories.title: DER ANDERE BLICK - Die sogenannte Mitte arbeitet mit aller Kraft an ihrem Niedergang

en.title: The other view - The so-called center is working hard on its own decline
en.summary: In recent elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, the Left Party and AfD displaced established political forces. These mainstream parties bear responsibility for their own losses.

stories.title: Ricola et HUG, deux PME familiales qui prospèrent malgré le franc fort et les tarifs douaniers américains

en.title: Ricola and HUG, two family SMEs thriving despite the strong franc and American tariffs
en.summary: Two Swiss food companies employ different strategies to withstand the franc's strength, American tariffs, and sluggish European consumption. Both enterprises continue to prosper despite these economic headwinds.

stories.title: Ce que signifie vraiment l’accord sur le Groenland voulu par Donald Trump, qui sera signé ce mardi à New York

en.title: What Donald Trump's desired Greenland agreement really means, to be signed Tuesday in New York
en.summary: The United States is consolidating an existing defense agreement with Greenland. Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen confirms that Denmark's sovereignty and Greenlanders' right to self-determination are respected.

stories.title: Avide de stabilité, Xi Jinping sera reçu jeudi à Washington par un Donald Trump en quête de rachat

en.title: Seeking stability, Xi Jinping will be received Thursday in Washington by Donald Trump seeking redemption
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump are meeting Thursday for a summit intended to project an image of peace and stability between the two powers, despite their fundamentally conflictual relationship.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Iran-Krieg: USA wollen iranische Fluggesellschaften weltweit isolieren +++ Huthi rücken in Jemen weiter vor

en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran war: USA wants to isolate Iranian airlines worldwide +++ Houthis advance further in Yemen
en.summary: The US and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026. Although they agreed to a ceasefire, Donald Trump declared it ended in early July. The ticker reports the latest developments.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Schweiz: 1500 Schweine müssen wegen Tierseuche getötet werden +++ SRG verkauft Musiksender an CH Media und Digris AG

en.title: BRIEF REPORTS - Switzerland: 1500 pigs must be killed due to animal disease +++ SRG sells music station to CH Media and Digris AG
en.summary: Switzerland is culling 1500 pigs due to an animal disease outbreak. The state broadcaster SRG is selling its music station to CH Media and Digris AG.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – USA wollen Irans Fluggesellschaften weltweit isolieren

en.title: Middle East War – USA wants to isolate Iran's airlines worldwide
en.summary: The United States threatens to impose sanctions on third countries that continue providing services to Iranian airlines starting Wednesday.

stories.title: Lungenkrankheit bei Schweinen – 1500 Schweine in sechs Kantonen müssen getötet werden

en.title: Lung disease in pigs – 1500 pigs in six cantons must be killed
en.summary: Swiss authorities are ordering the complete culling of pig herds across 20 affected breeding farms due to a lung disease outbreak.

stories.title: Granit Xhaka admet s’être procuré un faux certificat Covid et ne participera pas au rassemblement de la Nati

en.title: Granit Xhaka admits obtaining a fake Covid certificate and will not participate in the Swiss national team gathering
en.summary: Swiss captain Granit Xhaka has admitted to forging a Covid vaccination certificate and will miss the national team gathering and four upcoming matches through October 6. He is under investigation by Lucerne's prosecutor's office.

stories.title: Football - Granit Xhaka manque le rassemblement de la Nati après l'aveu d'un faux certificat Covid

en.title: Football - Granit Xhaka misses Swiss national team gathering after admitting to fake Covid certificate
en.summary: Switzerland will play its next four Nations League matches without captain Granit Xhaka, who admitted on Monday to using a forged Covid certificate.

en.title: Write-downs, protests, personnel changes: Volkswagen's situation is escalating
en.summary: Volkswagen faces mounting challenges including reduced planning, loss of a senior manager to a competitor, and ownership complications involving Chinese interests.

stories.title: Roche investiert Milliarden in den USA. Für einen Ersatzneubau in Basel reicht es trotzdem noch

en.title: Roche invests billions in the USA. For a replacement new building in Basel, however, it is still not enough
en.summary: Roche is constructing a new production facility at its Basel headquarters while management expresses concern that Switzerland has lost competitive ground, particularly on tax matters.

stories.title: Iran baut den Handel auf dem Landweg aus, eine Lösung für die Seeblockade ist dies aber nicht

en.title: Iran expands overland trade, but this is not a solution to the sea blockade
en.summary: Iran increasingly uses Pakistan's Gwadar deep-sea port for trade following US blockade of Iranian ports, though this alternative route faces significant limitations.

stories.title: Ein KI-Chatbot erstellt einen fehlerhaften Geheimdienstbericht – und die USA greifen auf dieser Basis fast ein chinesisches Schiff an

en.title: An AI chatbot produces a flawed intelligence report – and the USA nearly attacks a Chinese ship on this basis
en.summary: AI hallucinations and inaccurate data contributed to bombing a girls' school in Iran and nearly led to a US attack on a Middle Eastern vessel, illustrating risks of misplaced technological trust.
